_meta.session: Session 75 — Parallel PDF mining (Goedel-Prover-V2 + MedGemma 1.5 + GPT-5.5 + Step-Audio-R1.5)
_meta.notes: Parallel 4-agent mining of 4 PDFs. KEY FINDINGS: Goedel-Prover-V2-32B extended 92.7% MiniF2F NEW SOTA (was 90.4, +2.3pp). Gemini 3.0 Pro MedQA 95.1 NEW SOTA + MedMCQA 86.1 + MMLU Med 88.1 - new med dominance. GPT-5.5 UK AISI Cyber pass@5 90.5% + pass@1 66.7% + Biochem 32.32% reward@4 + Bio Tacit Knowledge GPT-5.5 Pro 81.67%. Step-Audio-R1.5 Avg 77.97 + Audio MC 41.15 + Step-DU 82.76 NEW SOTAs. MedGemma 1.5 4B EHRQA 89.6 + Chest ImaGenome 38 + WSI Histopath 49.4.
